root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from a buffer layout mismatch in the xfrm AH async completion callbacks where the 4-byte ESN sequence high bits (seqhi) slot allocated during the async setup phase is not accounted for when calculating offsets for the ICV and auth_data buffers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `net/ipv4/ah4.c` and `net/ipv6/ah6.c` to introduce `seqhi_len` and pointer arithmetic conditioned on `XFRM_STATE_ESN` in `ah_output_done`, `ah_input_done`, `ah6_output_done`, and `ah6_input_done`, ensuring the callback layout matches the setup path; CVE logs confirm the pre-fix offset drift (e.g., `icv_off=20 expected_off=24`) which is corrected by this alignment fix.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix AH output to include ESN sequence high bits in ICV calculation when XFRM_STATE_ESN flag is set
intent_record.what: Added seqhi_len and seqhi variables to handle Extended Sequence Number (ESN) support; introduced conditional check for XFRM_STATE_ESN flag; modified ah_tmp_icv() call to pass seqhi and seqhi_len instead of iph and ihl
intent_record.how: Enables proper ICV calculation for AH authentication when ESN is enabled by including the 4-byte sequence high field in the integrity check computation, ensuring correct cryptographic verification for extended sequence numbers

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes AH authentication data calculation to support Extended Sequence Number (ESN) mode by including the high-order sequence number bits in the authenticated data
intent_record.what: Added two new local variables (seqhi_len and seqhi), introduced a conditional check for XFRM_STATE_ESN flag to set seqhi_len to sizeof(__be32), and modified auth_data calculation to use seqhi pointer with seqhi_len instead of work_iph with ihl
intent_record.how: Enables proper authentication data calculation for IPsec AH packets using Extended Sequence Number (ESN) mode by accounting for the additional 4-byte sequence number high field, ensuring correct ICV verification for ESN-enabled security associations

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes incomplete ESN support in AH output by properly allocating and passing sequence high bits to the ICV calculation function
intent_record.what: Added two new local variables (seqhi_len and seqhi), introduced a conditional check for XFRM_STATE_ESN flag, and modified the ah_tmp_icv() call to pass seqhi pointer with seqhi_len instead of iph_ext with extlen
intent_record.how: Enables Extended Sequence Number (ESN) support for IPsec Authentication Header by reserving space for the high 32 bits of the sequence number in the ICV calculation area when ESN flag is set

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix AH authentication ICV offset calculation to support ESN mode by accounting for extended sequence number bytes
intent_record.what: Added two new local variables (seqhi_len and seqhi), introduced a conditional check for XFRM_STATE_ESN flag to set seqhi_len, and modified the ICV pointer calculation to account for ESN sequence high data offset
intent_record.how: Enables correct location of the Integrity Check Value (ICV) in IPv6 Authentication Header packets when Extended Sequence Number (ESN) mode is enabled, preventing authentication failures by skipping the 4-byte sequence high field before reading the ICV

grouping_result.intent: Fix AH authentication ICV offset calculation to support ESN mode by accounting for extended sequence number bytes

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix AH authentication ICV calculation to support Extended Sequence Number (ESN) mode by including high-order sequence number bits

relevance_review.reason: The vulnerability root cause identifies a buffer layout mismatch where ESN sequence high bits were not accounted for in offset calculations. The group's changes explicitly fix these offset calculations and ensure ESN high-order bits are included in the ICV calculation, directly resolving the described issue.

vuln_statements.explanation: This offset calculation in ah_output_done does not account for seqhi_len when ESN mode is enabled, causing the ICV buffer location to be incorrectly calculated and leading to buffer layout mismatch.
Similar to ah4.c, this offset calculation in ah6_output_done fails to add seqhi_len to the offset when ESN mode is active, resulting in the same buffer layout mismatch vulnerability for IPv6 packets.
